component.name: ThinkControl
component.summary: Lenovo Vantage Hardware Control Center for ThinkPad

description.p: ThinkControl provides an elegant, native Libadwaita control panel for Lenovo ThinkPad laptops on Linux (Zorin OS / Ubuntu).
Designed to mirror essential Lenovo Vantage capabilities natively and securely:

ul.li: Battery Conservation Mode (caps charge at 80% to protect battery longevity)
Custom Battery Charge Thresholds (configurable start and stop thresholds)
ACPI Platform Profiles (Quiet, Balanced, Extreme Performance)
Keyboard Backlight brightness switch (Off, Low, High)
ThinkPad iconic Red Dot Lid Logo LED toggle
Real-time CPU temperature and battery telemetry monitor

screenshot.caption: ThinkControl Main Dashboard showing battery and performance settings
